text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: eu-west inference queue latency spike detected — queue length for gpu-serving-pool-eu has grown to 820, 95th latency 1.9s (baseline 120ms). Autoscaler attempts failing. Paging oncall.
Maya: taking pager. saw the alert, joining bridge. any client-facing errors reported yet?
Priya: Customers reported increased tail latencies in EU, a few 5xxs from the load-balancer, sample ticket from acme-inc attached. not full outage but degraded UX.
Maya: copied. starting quick investigation — checking pool health and autoscaler logs.
Tom: fyi we had a rolling host eviction in eu-west-2a at 03:12 UTC for preemption, may have thinned capacity. I see multiple thin-prov nodes in draining state.
Maya: looking at node counts: gpu-serving-pool-eu desired=120 available=86, pending=2. autoscaler scale-up requests are being throttled due to capacity quota error. logs: `ERROR: insufficient quota for GPU_TYPE_A`
Lia: paging in. I can take infra ops. I can try temporarily spilling traffic to eu-central fallback pool and enable burst-reserve.
Maya: good plan. Priya, can you start customer comms (status page + short note)? Sam, assemble impact summary for SRE leads.
Priya: on it — drafting status: "Degraded inference performance in EU region; mitigation in progress; no data loss. Follow-up soon."
Sam: quick risk note: if we shift traffic we may see slightly higher latencies but fewer 5xxs — acceptable tradeoff.
Tom: executing spillover: run:
```
# reroute small fraction to eu-central
redwood-router reroute --from pool=gpu-serving-pool-eu --to pool=gpu-serving-pool-eu-central --pct=30 --mode=gradual
```
DeployBot: reroute job accepted (job_id=reroute-2160012345-1). monitoring policy: latency-slo check every 30s.
Maya: Lia, can you request temporary quota bump with cloud-provider? If they can't, we keep spillover and enable thin-prov warmup in eu-central.
Lia: submitted quota request (support ticket 842102). ETA from provider ~45m. Enabling warmup: `infra/warmup thin-prov eu-central target=40`
Tom: warmup started. I also manually reclaimed 6 preemptible hosts that were stuck in terminating state, freeing ~12 GPUs.
Aaron: running quick health query for affected routes: `select count(*),p95(latency) from requests where region='eu' AND hour>now()-1` returns 3.4k requests, p95 now 560ms (improved from 1.9s).
Maya: good sign. Priya, update ticket: mitigation in progress, we've shifted 30% of traffic to eu-central and warmed capacity.
Priya: updated status. added note: "Teams working on autoscaler fix and quota requests."
Maya: root-cause hypothesis so far: a coincident host eviction event + delayed thin-provision warmup + cloud quota limits prevented autoscaler from filling the delta. That created queue buildup.
Sam: agree. Also noted spikes in long-sequence requests that trip continuous-batching heuristics — need to flag for Optimize team.
Lia: for immediate mitigation actions: 1) maintain spillover at 30% until quota resolved, 2) increase warmup targets, 3) add short-lived local cache TTL to reduce repeated cold KV cache misses. I'll create specific runbook steps.
Maya: assign owners and Jira tasks now so nothing slips.
Maya: Jira: INF-1209 create autoscaler guardrail to fail open and not throttle scaleups during drain events — owner @Lia, due 3 days.
Maya: Jira: INF-1210 add thin-prov warmup metric and alert when pool warmup < threshold — owner @Tom, due 5 days.
Maya: Jira: INF-1211 temporary routing policy to allow controlled spillover — owner @Sam, due 1 day (post-incident cleanup).
Priya: I'm scheduling the post-incident review: proposed time tomorrow 1400 UTC. I'll add invite with bridge and recording.
Maya: we'll want the following attendees: SRE leads, infra, runtime, product (Optimize), and a customer success rep.
Sam: capturing action item: collect example request traces from 02:50-03:30 UTC and baseline p95 before/after. Owner: Sam.
Tom: also adding step: verify node termination lifecycle to avoid stuck-terminating hosts; I'll add logs to INF-1210.
Lia: immediate workaround implemented, observed p95 drop to ~300ms in EU after 10min. No new 5xxs reported in the last 12m.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Monitor: reroute-2160012345-1 shows 30% spillover healthy, latency SLO check OK for 3 consecutive intervals.
Maya: excellent. closing on-call for now, leaving Lia as secondary owner for the remainder of mitigation. Lia, if quota denied escalate to infra manager.
Lia: noted. I'll follow up on quota ticket and post an update in this thread.
-- 45 minutes later --
Lia: cloud provider responded: quota bump granted for 2 hours. I've validated scaleup to desired target; autoscaler requests now succeeding.
Tom: we scaled up pool to desired=120 available=122. draining spillover back down:
```
redwood-router reroute --from pool=gpu-serving-pool-eu --to pool=gpu-serving-pool-eu-central --pct=0 --mode=gradual
```
DeployBot: reroute job accepted (job_id=reroute-2160012345-2).
Priya: status update posted: "Mitigation complete, traffic restored to primary EU pool; postmortem scheduled." :memo:
Maya: nice work. closing incident from operational perspective but keeping thread open for postmortem tasks and tracking.
-- Next day (postmortem planning) --
Priya: reminder: postmortem at 1400 UTC in 2 hours. Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, customer impact, runbook updates.
Sam: attaching preliminary timeline and trace snippets in postmortem doc.
Maya: please include the autoscaler logs around 03:10-03:20 and the quota error blocks. I want exact error strings.
Tom: added logs. error excerpt:
```
2026-03-12T03:12:08Z ERROR autoscaler: scaleup denied: QuotaExceeded.GPU_TYPE_A quota=150 requested=170
2026-03-12T03:12:09Z WARN node-terminator: host i-0abc123 stuck in terminating
```
Maya: action review: confirm owners and SLAs for each Jira. Lia, can you own INF-1209 and push for a longer-term quota strategy with cloud accounts?
Lia: yes, I'll coordinate with procurement and cloud-ops for a permanent bump and pre-approved emergency scale windows.
Priya: customer impact summary for CS: ~4k affected requests, peak 5xx count 28 over 45 minutes, top impacted customers: Acme, BetaSoft. Draft ready for review.
Sam: adding quant: incremental cost for spillover ~ $120 for the hour (eu-central GPUs higher spot price) — include in postmortem cost annex.
Maya: final note: add a checklist to on-call runbook for "evacuation + quota check" and a short playbook for temporary spillover routing. Tom, Lia, please add runbook PRs by EOD.
Tom: will submit runbook PR INF-RB-87 with steps and commands.
Lia: will add guardrail proposal doc and a postmortem summary.
Priya: closing tasks: postmortem invite sent, recording enabled. Adding tags: gpu, autoscaler, quota, postmortem.
IncidentBot: :spiral_notepad: Postmortem scheduled (pm-2160012345).
-- 3 days later (remediation tracking update) --
Maya: quick sync: INF-1209 status?
Lia: INF-1209 in progress — design review done, implementing automatic quota fail-open for scaleups. PR opened: 3 changesets. ETA 2 days.
Tom: INF-1210 warmup metric implemented in staging, alert thresholds tuned. will roll to prod tomorrow.
Sam: INF-1211 routing policy cleaned up; spillover automation added to the console for emergency ops.
Priya: CS follow-ups done and customers notified of postmortem summary.
Maya: thanks team. leaving this thread as single source of truth for the incident timeline and remediation items. Marking operational mitigations as resolved, tracking remaining code changes via Jira.
Lia: closing note: suggest we run a tabletop next month to exercise spillover playbook.
Maya: agreed, schedule with Oncall rotation leads.
Priya: adding calendar invite: "Tabletop: EU spillover & quota" tentatively 4 weeks out.
Maya: nice work everyone. :heart:
